test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate choice.

During treatment, patients lay ______ on the treatment couch for around 3 hrs.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' **i.e.** 'Supine'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is looking for an adjective describing the position of the patients on the treatment couch.
 
• The word **'supine'** is the best fit in this context, which means lying face upwards. 
 
• **This implies** the patients are in a flat position with their faces up on the treatment couch.
 
• Thus the phrase 'patients lay supine' conveys the proper image of the patients' position during treatment.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'During treatment, patients lay **supine** on the treatment couch for around 3 hrs.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Arsine', 'alpine', and 'repine'** does not fit in this context as they do not describe a position. 
 
• **'Arsine'** is a type of gas,** 'alpine'** refers to mountainous areas, and** 'repine'** is a verb meaning to feel or express discontent.
